# FAQ

How do I change what a bot does? Edit its standing instructions on the bot page.
STANDING INSTRUCTIONS apply to every run. Standing Instructions are versioned.
Where are the Hub docs? Open Hub docs from the side bar.
Work goes through the runner on your computer, so Through the runner is how a bot reaches GitHub.
The runner pulls updates from the repository before each run. The runner syncs `AGENT.md` before the next run.

Our company keeps its washing machine and coworkers; keep `standing instructions` in code.
